title: Household Energy Consumption by Source in the UK (2000–2020)
prompt: The line graph below shows the amount of energy consumed by households in the UK from 2000 to 2020, measured in million tonnes of oil equivalent (Mtoe), across four sources: natural gas, electricity, oil, and renewables. Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant. Write at least 150 words.
instructions: 本题为模拟学术类雅思写作Task 1练习，所有数据与场景均为虚构，并非官方雅思试卷。请仔细阅读图表，注意四条折线在20年间的变化趋势、起点与终点数值以及相互之间的对比。写作时，先概述主要特征（如总体下降或上升趋势、最显著的变化），再选取关键数据点进行具体比较，无需描述每一个数据点。不要表达个人观点或解释原因。字数不少于150词。
